# Copilot instructions

This is a Python project that polls RSS feeds and stores them in SQLite.

Please follow these guidelines when suggesting code:

- Write clean, readable, well-documented code
- Use meaningful variable and function names
- Add type hints
- Follow PEP 8
- Write tests for new functionality
- Handle errors gracefully and never swallow exceptions

When opening a pull request, write the description in the imperative mood and
reference the issue number in the first line.
